coverages.description: Live coverage of the Cockroach Janta Party's protest movement — detentions, ultimatums, court cases, INDIA-bloc actions and on-ground developments in Delhi.
coverages.title: CJP Protest 2.0
coverages.current_summary: CJP's Jantar Mantar 2.0 protest continues with its leaders out on bond; founder Abhijeet Dipke delivered a written 24-hour ultimatum to Delhi Police on Oct 12 demanding protest permission and alleging custodial mistreatment, while the INDIA bloc has moved the Supreme Court against the SIR electoral-roll revisions.
